description: This file defines the Subscription controller class for managing scheduled subscription tasks within the OpenCart admin module. It extends the base Controller class and includes a method to initialize a subscription-related task using the system's task model.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for scheduling subscription tasks within the admin cron system, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up and adds a new subscription task to the system's task scheduler.
